name: mmeet_list_meetings
description: List the user's meetings, with participant counts. Pass `when` = 'upcoming' (scheduled, soonest first) or 'past'; omit for all, most-recent first. Each item has: slug, title, scheduled_start, scheduled_end (UTC ISO-8601 — convert to the timezone when reporting), timezone, status ('scheduled'|'live'|'ended'|'cancelled'), join_url, participant_count. Use this to find a meeting's `slug` before get/update/cancel.

when.description: Optional filter: 'upcoming' or 'past'. Omit for all.
